_help.usage: Copy this file as fs-spacemaker.config.json next to fs-spacemaker.exe (or pass --config). Every key is optional; command-line options win over this file.
_help.scan_threads: Parallel file reads during scan (default: CPU count, at most 8). Use 1-2 for a single mechanical hard disk.
_help.partial_hash_bytes: Bytes read from the start of a file for the cheap pre-filter (default 65536, minimum 4096).
_help.excluded_names: File or folder names never inventoried on either side (case-insensitive; a trailing * matches a prefix, e.g. .Trash-*). Trash folders are listed so a file in a trash is never taken as the copy that justifies a deletion.
_help.report_max_rows: Maximum rows per table in report.html, largest first (report.csv always has every row).
_help.include_empty_files: Content mode only: also delete empty source files (they free no space). Default false.
_help.delete_read_only: Also delete read-only source files. Default false (they are protected).
_help.remove_emptied_dirs: Remove source folders emptied by the deletions (never folders that were already empty). Default true. Merge mode always removes every empty source folder.
_help.ignored_stream_names: NTFS alternate data stream names holding no user data, ignored when comparing (a trailing * matches a prefix). Other streams must exist, byte-identical, on the destination copy. Example: ["com.dropbox.*"].
_help.remove_svn_metadata: Also remove Subversion metadata (.svn) once every file of its working copy has been deleted after verification (checked again at apply time). Git, Mercurial and Bazaar folders are never deleted. Default false.
_help.work_dir: Folder of the fingerprint index (default: fs-spacemaker-work in the installation folder: the project folder for a cargo build, else the executable folder).
_help.reports_dir: Folder of the plan, reports and journals (default: reports in the installation folder). Must not be inside the source.
